rules.description: Fund 5-Year Rolling Return Average must exceed Benchmark Average

rules.label: Sharpe Ratio
rules.description: Fund Sharpe Ratio must exceed Benchmark Sharpe Ratio

result.fundName: HDFC Balanced Advantage Fund - Growth Plan - Direct Plan

insights: HDFC Balanced Advantage Fund - Growth Plan - Direct Plan decisively outperforms its benchmark on rolling returns by 5.91% (16.26% vs 10.35%).
Beat the benchmark in 87.0% of rolling windows — strong consistency for a Hybrid: Dynamic Asset Allocation.
Sharpe ratio is near parity (0.87 vs 0.78) — similar risk-adjusted efficiency.
Aggressive profile: beta 1.43 with 18.0% annualised volatility vs benchmark 10.9%.
Positive alpha of 3.53% suggests manager skill beyond market exposure (info ratio 0.71).
Drawdown protection: max drawdown -34.20% vs benchmark -18.85% — shallower losses in downturns.
Rolling return range spans -3.70% to 33.77% (37.47 pp spread) — consistency score 92.
This fund satisfies all three Golden Triangle conditions.
